newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen range bound on economic worries.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen range bound on economic worries.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to move in a narrow range on Wednesday on a lack of new incentives and lingering concern about the slowing economy, brokers said.
"There were still no fresh factors to trigger much buying interest. Some consolidation might emerge after yesterday's gains," said one broker at Siam City Syndicate.
After six days of declines, the SET index on Tuesday closed up 8.06 points at 600.24 on 4.16 billion baht trade.
The key index is expected to move in a range between 590 and 610 points today, brokers said.
